description:
We built a small run of Little Wing framesets ahead of demand and are offering them at clearance pricing while they last. Each frame has been welded, aligned, and inspected by our team in Johnstown, NY. The only thing left is the finish, which we will apply on demand once your order is placed.
The Little Wing is our purpose-built titanium track and fixed-gear frame: a focused, tightly tuned platform built around power transfer, sharp handling, and the kind of ride feel that only titanium delivers. Track-style horizontal dropouts, a BSA bottom bracket for maximum crank compatibility, and a No. 6 Composites carbon fork round out the package.
What's included

Titanium Little Wing frame with horizontal track dropouts
Titanium seat mast topper (your choice of setback,)
No. 6 Composites carbon fork (your choice of brake or no-brake hole configuration)
Custom-machined titanium headset with Enduro stainless bearings

How clearance works
These frames are built but unfinished, which lets us offer a $700 savings off the standard MSRP without compromising on anything you can see or feel on the bike. Once you place your order, we will reach out to confirm your finish selection. Most finishes ship within 2-3 weeks of order.
Raw is included at no additional cost. Standard finish upgrades carry the same 15% clearance discount as the frame itself.

Customizable at no cost
Seat mast topper setback. Choose from our three standard offsets so you can dial in saddle position right out of the box.

Fork brake hole. Choose the configuration that matches how you intend to ride.

No front brake hole — clean track aesthetic for fixed-gear and velodrome use
Front brake hole — drilled for a standard road caliper, ideal for street-fixed riders

Both options are no cost.
Frame highlights

3Al-2.5V titanium throughout
BSA threaded bottom bracket for the widest possible crankset compatibility
Horizontal track dropouts
Hand-finished welds, expertly aligned, made entirely in Johnstown, NY

Ordering and next steps
These frames are available for immediate purchase at the clearance price shown above. Once your order is placed, we will follow up by email to confirm finish selection and review delivery timing.
